body: Crystalis is SNK's action role-playing adventure for the NES, set in a world recovering from a devastating war. A young man awakens without his memories and becomes involved in resistance to the Draygonian Empire. Villages, monsters and elemental magic occupy a landscape whose distant technological past gradually becomes important. The player explores from above, fighting directly while gathering equipment and experience. Its fantasy begins among familiar swords and sages, then connects those discoveries to the civilisation that left this changed world behind.

Four main swords carry the powers of wind, fire, water and thunder. Charging an attack releases an elemental projectile, and different enemies require different weapons. The same powers also change how the landscape can be crossed: the water sword can form ice bridges over suitable rivers, while other attacks remove barriers. Equipment therefore opens routes as well as improving combat. Returning to an earlier obstacle with another sword can reveal a way forward that was visible long before it was usable.

Defeated monsters provide experience, raising the hero's level and combat strength. Some enemies require a sufficient level before they can be damaged, making equipment and experience complementary parts of preparation. Armour, shields, spells and useful items broaden the choices available on a journey. The original NES game later joined the SNK 40th Anniversary Collection, while a Game Boy Color adaptation appeared in 2000. The adventure's identity remains closely tied to its elemental weapons: each discovery changes both the next fight and the map around it.
story_headings: Choose the sword for the obstacle
